summary: Unpinned GitHub mutable-ref dependency resolves attacker-controllable code at install
details: package.json declares optionalDependencies."fca-unofficial" as the bare GitHub reference github:VangBanLaNhat/fca-unofficial with no commit SHA, tag, or integrity hash. npm install resolves this to whatever HEAD of that third-party repository is at install time; whoever controls that repository controls the bytes installed on the installer's machine. The e2ee vendor bundle shipped in this package requires("fca-unofficial"), so that dependency's code is loaded into the installer's Node process at library load. The repository owner is not the publisher of this npm package, and the dependency is not resolved from the npm registry, so none of the registry's integrity, provenance, or secret-scanning checks apply. Other code in the package shows base64 decoding and ping command strings inside the e2ee module tree, but the primary installer-side exposure is the mutable off-registry resolution path.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
